basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, with a knack for pushing hardware to its limits. When I'm not tweaking my PC, I'm exploring new places to eat oysters or diving into data visualization with Tableau. I work as a systems analyst and enjoy spending my evenings and weekends tinkering with tech or hanging out on Reddit. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility it offers to pursue my hobbies. I usually browse Reddit in the late evenings, around 8 PM to midnight CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and a passion for hardware mods, which I've honed through years of self-teaching and experimenting. My job as a systems analyst requires a deep understanding of technology, which I often apply to my personal projects.
